title: WebGL2 in Action: VANTA//7 — A Cyberpunk Life-Sim MMORPG in Your Browser
author: Particular-Let9884
selftext:
Hey everyone,

For the past weeks I've been building VANTA//7, a first-person cyberpunk life-simulation MMORPG built with WebGL 2 via Three.js and running directly in your browser.

No download. No account. No install.

▶ Test the Alpha: [https://vanta7.higgsfield.app](https://vanta7.higgsfield.app)

# The world

You wake up in Kōwa-Bas, a rain-soaked neon district built over the remains of a world where humans have disappeared.

But they are not completely gone.

Fragments of their identities, memories and faces still survive inside the machines they left behind. Some robots project holographic human faces, trying to imitate the people they once knew — or perhaps the people they once were.

You are not a chosen one. You're a nobody who has to survive, work, build relationships, grow stronger and slowly understand what happened here.

# An AI-driven world

The world is managed by an AI system that organizes and adapts the city as you play.

Missions and combat can be shared with other players, so you can team up and fight through the same events together.

At the same time, your personal world keeps evolving around your own progress — your relationships, upgrades, apartment, Relay, choices and progression can develop differently from another player's.

The idea is to have a world that feels shared, while still evolving personally for each player.

# What you can do

* Play missions with other players: team up and complete shared multiplayer objectives together
* Fight together: multiple players can take part in the same combat encounters
* Real RPG progression: gain levels, become stronger, unlock abilities and install cybernetic modules on your character to create your own build
* Classes: Gunner is playable now, with Blade and Support coming later
* Have your own apartment: rent your own place in the city, furnish it, decorate it and make it feel like home
* Actually live in the city: manage hunger, energy and mood, eat, sleep and take on odd jobs
* See other players live: other players walk through the same streets in real time
* Named NPCs with daily routines and relationships
* Rebuild The Relay: restore an underground hub module by module — generator, ripperdoc workshop, chip foundry, pirate antenna and more
* Drive and fly: steal cars, drive in third person and use flying vehicles above the city
* Explore a living city: day/night cycle, changing weather and interconnected alleys
* Lawless zones: hacked robot gangs control parts of the backstreets
* Police response: attack civilians in the main streets and police drones will come after you
* Fully voiced in English and French with Elevenlabs and Gemini.

And if you see another player in the rain, say hi. 🌧️
